reading.body:
J-Curve Technologies is not a confirmed data center, and should not be counted toward Arizona's AI power load.

The entry rests on a single OpenStreetMap node tagged as a data center at coordinates that reverse geocode to a building on West 14th Street in Tempe, Arizona. No operator website, business registration, or press coverage naming the company at that address could be found, and research status is recorded as exhausted. The name itself is a finance term for a growth pattern, not an established technology brand.

Arizona has 56 mapped data center facilities, and only 4 of them publish power specifications, totaling 512 MW. This facility publishes none, so it cannot be ranked against them. The absence of a confirmed operator, a published capacity figure, or any evidence of server rooms and colocation space is why it does not enter calculations of grid load or AI scaling constraints in the state.

What the data does not establish is whether a data center exists here at all. It records a failed verification, not a confirmed absence, and the search was bounded. The coordinates sit about 2.5 miles from Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport, which is proximity to an airport and nothing more.
